profile_text: With a strong presence in the German media landscape, this Düsseldorf-based firm specializes in delivering a range of media services, driving its remarkable 338.5% growth since the baseline. As a key player in the wholesale and retail trade sector, its expertise in media solutions has enabled the company to expand its workforce to 57 employees by 2024. Its success can be attributed to its ability to provide tailored media services, catering to the evolving needs of its clients.
